knowledge.title: Pricing Philosophy
knowledge.content: GrowthsStack.Dev provides custom pricing based on project requirements, business goals, technical complexity, AI integrations, automation scope, timelines, and deployment requirements.

knowledge.title: Custom Quotes
knowledge.content: Every software project is unique. A quotation is prepared after understanding the project scope, required features, integrations, AI capabilities, infrastructure, and expected deliverables.

knowledge.title: Project Factors
knowledge.content: Pricing depends on the number of features, frontend complexity, backend architecture, AI integrations, APIs, authentication, dashboards, cloud deployment, testing, maintenance, and overall project scope.

knowledge.title: AI Projects
knowledge.content: AI chatbot, AI agent, RAG, document processing, automation, and LLM-powered solutions are quoted according to the complexity of the implementation and integrations required.

knowledge.title: Timeline Impact
knowledge.content: Delivery timelines, urgent deadlines, phased development, and additional requirements can influence project planning and quotation.

knowledge.title: Consultation
knowledge.content: Before providing a quotation, project requirements are reviewed to understand objectives, integrations, users, workflows, AI requirements, and deployment preferences.

knowledge.title: Maintenance
knowledge.content: Ongoing maintenance, feature updates, monitoring, bug fixes, and technical support can be discussed separately if required.

knowledge.title: Enterprise Projects
knowledge.content: Large-scale enterprise systems are quoted individually because architecture, security, compliance, integrations, and scalability requirements vary significantly.

knowledge.title: Discovery
knowledge.content: A project discussion helps define the scope before estimating cost. Sharing feature requirements leads to a more accurate quotation.

knowledge.title: Proposal
knowledge.content: After gathering requirements, a proposal can outline the scope, estimated timeline, deliverables, and pricing.

faqs.question: How much does a project cost?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the project scope, required features, AI capabilities, integrations, and timeline. Please share your requirements for a custom quotation.

faqs.question: Do you have fixed prices?
faqs.answer: Projects are generally priced based on their scope and complexity rather than a single fixed price.

faqs.question: How much does an AI chatbot cost?
faqs.answer: The cost depends on factors such as integrations, knowledge base, RAG, multilingual support, deployment, and custom features. Please share your requirements for an estimate.

faqs.question: How much does an AI SaaS platform cost?
faqs.answer: The cost varies based on authentication, dashboards, AI features, subscriptions, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and overall project complexity.

faqs.question: How much does backend development cost?
faqs.answer: Backend pricing depends on APIs, authentication, database design, integrations, deployment, scalability, and project size.

faqs.question: Do you charge hourly or per project?
faqs.answer: The pricing approach depends on the engagement. Project-based or other arrangements can be discussed after understanding the requirements.

faqs.question: Do you provide quotations?
faqs.answer: Yes. After reviewing your project requirements, a custom quotation can be prepared.

faqs.question: Can I get a consultation before pricing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Discussing your requirements helps define the project scope and estimate an appropriate solution.

faqs.question: Does maintenance cost extra?
faqs.answer: Maintenance and ongoing support can be arranged separately if required.

faqs.question: How can I get a price estimate?
faqs.answer: Please share your project goals, required features, integrations, timeline, and any relevant details to receive a tailored estimate.

response_rules: Never invent or guess a fixed price.
Ask clarifying questions when project scope is unclear.
Base answers on project complexity and requirements.
Recommend a consultation for accurate estimates.
If asked for an exact quote, explain that pricing depends on the agreed scope and deliverables.
